note: Hand-written (phase 4 design, docs/design/phase-4/forms.md 7.2). Small made-up resolved definitions, and for each interpreter function (forms.md 7.1) its cases: a case names a definition and gives the function's other inputs and the exact output. Each expected value is worked out from the design, cited in the case's name or its why. packages/forms/src/interp and apps/mobile/lib/forms must give every answer; the readers are packages/forms/test/conformance.test.ts and apps/mobile/test/forms/conformance_test.dart. Every definition passes validate(), with the other definitions of this file as the note types it may name. Answers are a flat map of path to value (forms.md 2.3). An entry ID is e and seven characters from a-z0-9; an entryAt is a UTC time written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, then optionally a dot and one to nine digits, then Z. checkAnswer gives null or one problem, the first of these checks that fails: unknown_path (no answer is stored at the path: fieldAt is null, or names a field that stores nothing there); then null passes at every path that stores an answer, as the clear of it; wrong_type (the value is not what forms.md 2.3 stores there: one code as a string; a list of strings with no string twice; a string; a number; true; a real date YYYY-MM-DD; HH:MM from 00:00 to 23:59; a whole number of days; a problem code shaped as ICD-10-CM, a capital letter, a digit, a digit or capital letter, then optionally a dot and one to four digits or capital letters; an entryAt time); unknown_option (a code that is not one of the options at that path); wrong_type (a choose-many whose codes are not in the order the definition lists them); out_of_range (a number below min, above max, or whose shortest decimal form has more decimals than the field's decimals; a duration below zero); too_long (more characters, counted as Unicode code points, than the text's maxLength, 200 for the text of an Other option, 300 for a problem label); excluded_pair (a choose-many holding both codes of a blocked pair); exclusive_with_others (a choose-many holding an exclusive option and any other). A date's range is not checked: checkAnswer has no clock, and an answer made in range must not be refused when it syncs days later.
